== Description ==

A late-night game at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025, with [[Amar Banger]] (front left, olive hoodie), [[Greg Shaw]] (back left, red hoodie), [[Kyle Krueger]] (back center, dark zip jacket), [[Jarad Konsker]] (mid-right, black T-shirt), and a player in a tan cap and blue T-shirt (front right).
